periods.time: Final day of the Seven Stars Festival
periods.label: 观测未来的总理

status.current: observes the final and hears Edelweiss confirm Ikki's value against a despair-filled future
status.condition: still pursuing political aims after Akatsuki's tournament defeat

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Young Akatsuki contractor he reassures after their losses.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Akatsuki member present under Color Magic concealment.
relationships.edelweiss: World-class contact who asks him for a seat and explains the meaning of Ikki's awakening.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Young knight whose childhood effort Tsukikage once witnessed and whose future importance he now sees.

periods.summary: Tsukikage is revealed to have helped secure the final's postponement. Before the match he meets Rinna, Charlotte and Sara, forgives Akatsuki's failure, and says politics requires finding other means. Edelweiss warns him of foreign agents and reminds him of the future calamity he has seen. After Ikki's impossible awakening, Tsukikage accepts Edelweiss's claim that Ikki and Stella might become hope against that future, recalling the lonely boy he once saw practicing at the Kurogane estate.

key_events.summary: Is mentioned as having aided the special decision to delay the final.
Meets Edelweiss and is warned about foreign agents and future threats.
Hears that Ikki's awakening may create a new, more hopeful future.

periods.time: Night after the Seven Stars award ceremony
periods.label: 揭露魔人与未来灾厄
periods.affiliation: Japanese government; International Mage-Knight League member state leadership

status.current: abandons his failed anti-League plan and entrusts Japan's future to the younger generation
status.condition: emotionally exhausted after a decade of trying to avoid a foretold disaster

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Informs him of the Desperado realm and asks him to keep it secret.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Shows her the future destruction of Tokyo and explains why the League hides Desperado knowledge.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Former student/associate who witnesses his confession.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Named as one of Japan's known Desperado and witnesses the explanation.

periods.summary: Tsukikage summons Ikki, Stella, Kurono, and Nene to the empty Bay Dome. After Ascaride tests Ikki and Stella, Tsukikage explains that Ikki has become a Desperado: someone who has stepped outside the planet's fate and can grow beyond fixed magical limits. He then reveals Moon Heaven Jewel, a national secret Device that can view the past and sometimes show future memories, displaying a future in which Tokyo is devastated by war. He explains that the impending death of Rebellion's Tyrant may collapse the three-power balance and cause World War III, which drove his attempt to move Japan away from the League. Seeing Ikki and Stella break fate convinces him to entrust the future to them instead.

key_events.summary: Arranges the meeting where Ikki learns about Desperado.
Confesses the future vision behind his political actions.

periods.label: 以月天宝珠读取惨剧的日本首相

status.current: attempting to notify the League when communications fail and SCION approaches
status.condition: unharmed but alarmed by worsening future risks

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Ally who supported his Seven Stars reform attempt and asks him to read the past.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: His previous reliance on Rebellion indirectly led Or-Gaule to Stella and Ikki's circle.

periods.summary: Tsukikage accompanies the Kazamatsuri group to the devastated Rebellion headquarters, apologizes to Kozo for failing to achieve Japan's break from the League, and agrees to inspect the past with Moon Heaven Jewel. He witnesses Or-Gaule's massacre, Wallenshtein's death, the formation of Or-Gaule's breakaway faction, and their plan to destroy Vermillion and Quedland. He recognizes the crisis as partly tied to his earlier use of underworld power and decides to inform the International Mage-Knight League immediately. Before he can reach them, communications fail and SCION's Abraham Carter approaches the base, suggesting the world is moving toward the future Tsukikage feared.

key_events.summary: Uses Moon Heaven Jewel to reconstruct the massacre and identify Or-Gaule's plan.

periods.time: Two weeks before the final narration, ruined Rebellion headquarters
periods.label: 在三强制衡崩坏现场被美国质问的日本首相

status.current: at the ruined Rebellion headquarters when PSYON arrives and is asked to choose a side
status.condition: unharmed; protected by Kazamatsuri-side fighters who are told not to resist
status.goal: not stated in this volume; presence implies involvement in the post-Rebellion realignment

personality.summary: Politically enigmatic, present at a dangerous geopolitical turning point without revealing his hand.

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Present alongside him at Rebellion headquarters when PSYON arrives.
relationships.abraham-carter: Directly questioned by Abraham about whether he is enemy or ally.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: One of the young fighters attempting to protect him and Kozo.

periods.summary: In the epilogue, Tsukikage is present with Kazamatsuri Group president Kozo Kazamatsuri at the destroyed Rebellion headquarters in the Alps, a site whose destruction has collapsed the old balance among League, Union and Rebellion. Rinna, Charlotte and Sara prepare to defend Kozo and Tsukikage when American PSYON troops arrive, but Kozo orders them to stop because Abraham Carter is too strong. Abraham lands before Tsukikage and Kozo, names them, and asks whether they will be enemies or allies of the United States/world justice and which side they belong to. The volume ends before Tsukikage answers.

key_events.summary: Is confronted by Abraham Carter at ruined Rebellion HQ.

periods.time: U.S. invasion pretext and Tsushima report
periods.label: 被宣称逮捕又突然归国的总理

status.current: reported protected at Tsushima Base, contradicting U.S. claims that he was captured and confessed
status.condition: alive; circumstances of return unresolved in this volume

relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Itsuki acts under emergency authority while Tsukikage is absent and later receives the report of his protection.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Reported to be accompanied by Itsuki's son when reaching Tsushima Base.
relationships.united-states: U.S. leadership uses an alleged confession from him as pretext to accuse the League of controlling Rebellion.

periods.summary: Tsukikage remains offscreen for most of the volume, but the U.S. Pacific Fleet claims that America's PSYON captured him at a Rebellion base and extracted testimony that the International Mage-Knight League controlled Rebellion. Itsuki judges the claim suspicious because the U.S. does not show him publicly, yet the accusation becomes the pretext for the invasion of Japan. At the end, the Integrated Operations Center receives an urgent report from Tsushima Base that Tsukikage has been protected and is safe, overturning the invasion pretext and creating a new crisis of information.

key_events.summary: U.S. forces cite his alleged capture and confession as the reason for military action.
Tsushima Base reports that Tsukikage is safe and accompanied by Ikki.

periods.time: From the Alps investigation to the aftermath of Tokyo's defense
periods.label: 仍未结束的预知梦

status.current: rescued to Tsushima base but unconscious from prophetic nightmares
status.condition: physically and mentally damaged by Abraham's interrogation and still warning that the disaster has not begun

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Co-conspirator in trying to control Rebellion and preserve the postwar balance.
relationships.carl-arlanz: Interrogator and political enemy who tries to force him to condemn the League and Japan.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage-family: Refuses Arlanz's offer to protect relatives in exchange for collaboration.
relationships.stella-vermillion: One of the young fighters whose generation defeats the Tokyo future he feared, though her abduction confirms a deeper threat.

periods.summary: Tsukikage accompanies Kazamatsuri's group to the Rebellion base so his history-reading ability can confirm what happened and protect the Tyrant. Captured by Abraham and Arlanz, he deduces that the United States intends to declare itself justice and start war by blaming the League alone for Rebellion's manipulation. He withstands brainwashing and refuses to become a traitorous witness even when Rinna and Sara are tortured. After Ouma and Nango rescue the captives, Tsukikage collapses on the return trip. In Tsushima he remains trapped in prophetic nightmares: even after Japan defeats the US fleet, he warns Kazamatsuri that the true disaster has not yet begun.

key_events.summary: Identifies the US plan as a war pretext built on one-sided justice.
Refuses Arlanz's demand that he testify as a League conspirator.
Collapses during the flight home and later warns that the nightmare is not over.

periods.time: After awakening in a Kansai hospital
periods.label: 从火海预知中醒来的总理

status.volume_role: recovered statesman and witness to changed future

personality.summary: Tsukikage is weary and self-critical after years of acting from fear of a future Tokyo inferno. He accepts that he failed to trust the younger generation enough and joins Itsuki in shouldering their generation's responsibility.
flaws: underestimated younger knights' capacity to change fate

relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Discusses the postwar settlement and agrees to reveal/end the old Rebellion-based arrangement.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Was rescued and transported back to Japan by Ouma before this volume's main rescue begins.
relationships.young-knights: Recognizes that Ikki's generation resolved crises while he slept and should not inherit the old system's debts.

periods.summary: Tsukikage awakens after repeatedly dreaming of Tokyo burned to hellish ruins, the future vision that once drove his political maneuvers. Itsuki briefs him on the Union's decision to avoid harsh escalation against the League and on Fu Xiaoli's defeat of Eilands, creating a diplomatic compromise. Tsukikage admits his mistake: he feared for Japan and acted through plans such as Akatsuki because he did not sufficiently trust the young generation. He agrees with Itsuki that the leaders who maintained Rebellion as a necessary evil must expose and end that arrangement, taking blame themselves so the next generation can inherit a cleaner world.

key_events.summary: Wakes from the Tokyo-fire vision and agrees with Itsuki to end the hidden Rebellion-era system.
